title: Ask the AI teacher about a memory card
summary: Memory cards now offer a teacher button that opens a contextual explanation of the current term and definition in the selected language.

changes.detail: Added a localized AI teacher button below Flip card. It passes the current card term and translated definition, asks for a simple explanation and practical example, and starts the existing contextual teacher flow.
